thesis: Empirical findings inform moral judgment without directly determining individual blame or duty.

ideas.statement: Group averages, observational associations, experiments and units of analysis must remain distinct.
Correct findings still need normative premises before determining treatment of people.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Individual helping and any-member helping answer different questions.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No detected difference does not establish equivalence.

audit.notes: All assigned units read. Claims remain bounded; hypothetical cases are not empirical evidence.
